title: Purchase order line lookup does not offer an inactive part
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-POLOOK-01), with description {Description-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL POLOOK PART A), is tracked at {Location-A} with 4 in its default bin and is inactive.
  • Vendor {Vendor-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL POLOOK Vendor) exists.
  • Purchase order {Purchase-order-A} (for example PO-1234) for {Vendor-A} is open, not yet received, and holds one line for vendor part {Number-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-POLOOK-VEND-01).
custom_steps:
1. Go to Parts → Purchase Orders and open {Purchase-order-A}.
  2. Add a new line to {Purchase-order-A} with the purchase order's add-part control.
  3. Type the start of {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-POL) in the new line's Part Number.
  4. Clear Part Number and type {Part-A} in full, all in lower case.
  5. Close the new line without saving it.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: No row for {Part-A} is offered.
  • Step 4: The lookup shows "{Part-A} is inactive. Activate it from the Inactive tab to use it." in place of the offer to add the typed number, naming {Part-A} as it was saved.
  • Step 5: {Purchase-order-A} still holds only the {Number-A} line.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S9-R5, S9-R16, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas 13 Oct copy: no board shows a purchase order; the message wording is on board 6.3 (Typing the retired number in full). Tech plan "Parts Lifecycle Update — Technical Implementation Plan", 7 Oct 2026 (informs, never overrules), §6 Phase 7. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R5: “Part lookup on a purchase order line does not return inactive parts.”
  • S9-R16: “When the number typed in a part lookup matches an inactive part at this location, the lookup does not offer to add it as a special order. It shows "{part number} is inactive. Activate it from the Inactive tab to use it.", naming the inactive part's number. On technician charge-out, where a typed number is taken straight from the field, the field shows the same message as its error and the line cannot be saved.”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Retired number typed in a part lookup): “"{part number} is inactive. Activate it from the Inactive tab to use it." | Shown in the lookup in place of the special order offer; on technician charge-out, error under the field”
  • Tech plan (Parts Lifecycle Update, 7 Oct 2026), §6 Phase 7, ListingQueryHandler: “Covers WO, estimate, tech charge-out (every device), PO, vendor-bill re-point, part sale”
